snippet.title: Grand Opening: The Apothecary Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4989570/Grand_Opening_The_Apothecary/

Tidy up your cozy apothecary by organizing every potion, herb, and alchemy accessory after a rival store owner sabotaged your store. Explore the shop, put away over 3,000 items, and solve puzzles to unlock more areas and items.
